name: Eyes of The Executioner
body:
School divination; Level alchemist 1, antipaladin 1, inquisitor 1, lathspell 1, legendary ninja 1, ranger 1

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range self
Target you
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You enhance your vision, seeing under the skin of creatures before you, seeing their weaknesses and vital organs. You gain a +2 bonus on attack and damage rolls when making precision-based attacks, like sneak attack, or when confirming and dealing damage on a critical hit.
